answer: That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator burns the bond and the raven fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. Because the pulse cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the ivory audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 58 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 58 of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
